title: Bounded account-enrolment workflow
product_claim: Demonstrates the workflow model and evidence structure; it is not a customer deployment or a live provider receipt.
goal: Create one zero-cost programme account using sourced company data, preserve state around a human verification gate, and verify the resulting account without duplicating the action.

authority.terms_policy: only an exact pre-approved document digest may be accepted

trace.evidence: workflow, identity, origin and consequence classes recorded
field source recorded; value excluded from public trace
opaque credential handle consumed once; secret excluded from receipts
gate lease bound to workflow, browser session, origin, page digest and action
signed completion accepted once; replay rejected
page and operation identity revalidated before mutation

trace.action: execute the bound account-creation action once
trace.evidence: worker, adapter, operation, exit status and result digests bound together
confirmation marker and durable receipt recorded; duplicate submit disabled

public_boundaries: No passwords, cookies, OTP values, recovery codes, device addresses or private provider responses are included.
The trace is synthetic and intentionally provider-neutral.
A real deployment may stop at provider controls that cannot be automated or delegated lawfully.
